scripts.dev: pnpm run check:runtime && rspack serve --mode development --config rspack.config.mjs
scripts.build: pnpm run check:runtime && rspack build --mode production --config rspack.config.mjs
scripts.lint: pnpm run check:runtime && biome lint src tests
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run check:runtime && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.domain.json
scripts.test: pnpm run check:runtime && rstest run --config rstest.config.mjs
scripts.test:coverage: pnpm run check:runtime && rstest run --config rstest.config.mjs --coverage --coverage.provider v8 --coverage.reporters text-summary --coverage.reporters json-summary --coverage.reportsDirectory reports/coverage
scripts.test:e2e: pnpm run check:runtime && playwright test --config playwright.config.mjs && playwright test --config playwright.pwa.config.mjs
scripts.test:mutation: pnpm run check:runtime && stryker run stryker.config.mjs
scripts.test:mutation:hardening: pnpm run check:runtime && stryker run stryker.preview-server.config.mjs && stryker run stryker.preloaded-glb-resource.config.mjs && stryker run stryker.project-mutation-publication.config.mjs && stryker run stryker.catalog-wall-domain.config.mjs && stryker run stryker.recovery-codec.config.mjs && stryker run stryker.recovery-controller.config.mjs && stryker run stryker.recovery-resources.config.mjs && stryker run stryker.recovery-publication.config.mjs
